## Concept

The goal here is to visualize the relationship between maize-legume intercropping and food security. We refer to this framework during the cleaning and analyses. This is an iterative process... 

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: false
#| warning: false
library(dagitty)
library(ggdag)
```

```{r}
# assumed DAG framework
coords <- data.frame(matrix(c("intercrop",0,0,
                              "nutrition",4,0,
                              "social",1,1,
                              "conservation",2,1,
                              "gender",3,1,
                              "plot",2,0.5), nrow=6, ncol=3, byrow = T))
colnames(coords) <- c("name", "x", "y")
dag <- dagify(nutrition~intercrop+social+conservation+gender+plot,
              intercrop~social+conservation+gender+plot,
              exposure = "intercrop",
              outcome="nutrition",
              coords = coords)
#plot
ggdag_classic(dag, text_col = "blue") + theme_dag_blank()
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
survey_data <- tribble(
  ~Country,      ~Wave, ~StartYear, ~EndYear,
  "Ethiopia",    "Wave 4", 2018, 2018,
  "Ethiopia",    "Wave 5", 2021, 2021,
  "Malawi",      "Wave 1", 2010, 2010,
  "Malawi",      "Wave 2", 2013, 2013,
  "Malawi",      "Wave 3", 2016, 2016,
  "Malawi",      "Wave 4", 2019, 2019,
  "Tanzania",    "Wave 4", 2014, 2014,
  "Tanzania",    "Wave 5", 2020, 2021
)

library(ggplot2)

# Gantt-style plot
ggplot(survey_data, aes(x = StartYear, xend = EndYear, 
                        y = fct_rev(factor(Country)), 
                        yend = fct_rev(factor(Country)))) +
  geom_label(aes(x = StartYear, label = Wave), 
            size = 5, fill="#D4FF1D", color="blue") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2009, 2021, by = 1),
                     limits = c(2008, 2022) ) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, color = "blue"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, color = "blue"))
```
